{{Top|leg}}
The '''Casino Kuari''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on board the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] with decor based on [[Naweenen Fate Rooms]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Located on the [[Recreation Deck]], the games that were played in the casino included [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], [[Tregald]], [[Lugjack/Legends|Lugjack]], [[Binspo/Legends|Binspo]] and [[Compmatch]].
